lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two scientists in Australia worked this out by tracking every *atom* in ten kilos of fat.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ten kilos of fat plus twenty nine kilos of oxygen went *in*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Twenty eight kilos of carbon dioxide and eleven kilos of water came *out*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Both sides weigh thirty nine kilos, so not a single atom went *missing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And no, panting on the sofa will not burn more fat. You will just get *dizzy*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: From now on, every breath out carries a tiny piece of yesterday's *dinner*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So where did that kilo on your scale go? You breathed it *out*.
